audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The nonlocal inner products and coercivity fail in the admitted two-dimensional zero-parameter case; The zero-frequency compatibility conditions are vacuous because the two kernels are interchanged; The mixed Hodge–Laplace representation has reversed boundary signs
limitations: Limitations: No equivalence to the December 2022 revision or journal VoR was assumed.
Limitations: General Lipschitz trace/lifting, global Gaffney and compact-manifold kernel theorems were not independently reproved.
Limitations: No author code was run. Historical initial full-source coverage and actual page views remain attributed to their original performers.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: The nonlocal inner products and coercivity fail in the admitted two-dimensional zero-parameter case

Recorded check: The zero-frequency compatibility conditions are vacuous because the two kernels are interchanged

Recorded check: The mixed Hodge–Laplace representation has reversed boundary signs

Recorded check: The Newton-potential target in (3.3) incorrectly includes second-order graph regularity across its source

Recorded check: The representation hypotheses do not imply the componentwise graph traces used in their proofs

Recorded check: Several displayed operators have incompatible degree labels
